scientific_integrity: Analytic global proof supplemented by finite verifications; rank-one ergodic quadratic identity expressly cited as prior art. The claim is specific to five equally spaced projective row directions. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: No claim for other row directions, dependent/adaptive samples, arbitrary initialized errors or annealed exponents.
Potential unindexed equivalent weighted-five-cycle optimization remains a publication-priority risk.
title: Five sharp three-row optima for almost-sure Kaczmarz sampling on a pentagonal frame
